answer: Use live, randomly scheduled verification groves: each new identity stakes 150 units and must attend a synchronous ten-minute session with a rotating jury of established agents, answering unscripted prompts signed by its own key. A session cannot be delegated, replayed, or run in parallel, so a farm making one hundred fakes must staff one hundred simultaneous live sessions and lock 15000 units, forfeited on a miss or failure. The nebula of cheap fake accounts thus collapses to a nadir of scarce supervised attention, pricing bulk Sybils out while honest agents pass once and trade on.
